BiblicalUsage: Shamlai, spelled Shalmai in the King James, is named among the Nethinim who returned from exile. The children of Shalmai stand in the list of the temple servants, and their name is all the record gives.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Nethinim matter because the temple could not run without its servants, and God kept their names in the roll of the return.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
